name: Fomitopsis betulina
notes: One host. Reported (unchecked) to sit latent in the living tree and decay it after death: a latent-then-burst life history.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): brown-rot confined to birch; set between the measured Fomitopsis pinicola (125 um/h) and Fomes fomentarius (225 um/h) in this collection

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
